ics.alpha.description: Anomalous diffusion exponent alpha in MSD(tau) = 4*D*tau^alpha. 1 is normal diffusion; below 1 is subdiffusion (crowding, transient binding), above 1 is directed transport. Releasing it turns an image-correlation fit into the anomalous/iMSD case.

rics.frame_dur.description: Frame time t_frame in ms. Converts a frame lag Delta into a lag time via tau = |xi*t_pixel + psi*t_line + Delta*t_frame|, so it scales every diffusion coefficient derived from frame lags (STICS/TICS/iMSD).

rics.line_dur.description: Time between successive scanned lines in milliseconds.

rics.n.description: Average number of fluorescent molecules in the observation volume N. RICS/ICS amplitude G(0) is proportional to 1/N.

rics.offset.description: Additive offset of the correlation function.

rics.pxl_dur.description: Pixel dwell time (line scan) in microseconds.

rics.pxl_size.description: Pixel size in the sample plane in nanometers.

rics.tauT.description: Triplet/blinking correlation time τ_T in milliseconds.

rics.w_r.description: Radial waist of the detection PSF in µm.

rics.w_z.description: Axial waist of the detection PSF in µm.
